card.name: The after During, before initial phase
card.fires_on: The word "the" right after "During" at the start of the sentence "During the initial phase of combination antiretroviral therapy", in immune reconstitution syndrome warnings. Also a possessive after "early in".

modes.label: During the initial phase
modes.description: "the" after sentence-opening "During" in immune reconstitution syndrome warnings, just before "initial phase".

modes.label: Early in their illness
modes.description: "their" after "early in" in a warning about early-illness behavior changes.
modes.example: may be at an increased risk of confusion or abnormal behavior early in<< their>> illness.
